multisig.note: Fixed 2-of-2 with Muun's server (P2WSH or MuSig2 P2TR); the person holds one key, cannot add keys or choose cosigners

hw_signer.note: Keys live in the app. A flag-gated NFC Security Card only signs a 2FA challenge (mock backend in libwallet), not transactions

psbt.note: Server returns a partly signed tx in Muun's own API format, the app signs and pushes it back; no PSBT import or export

watch_only.note: Get Started offers only create new wallet or recover existing (email or recovery code); every wallet holds its own key

passphrase.note: No BIP 39 phrase: the key is a random 32-byte seed; the optional password only encrypts the key backup, it is not a wallet variant

coin_control.note: The server supplies the ordered UTXO list (next transaction size) and a send spends in that order; no coin picker

fee_bump.note: No speed-up button or RBF; a new send adds a CPFP bump for unconfirmed parent coins, only while the backend flag is on

taproot.note: P2TR (MuSig2) offered in the Receive address picker and as default in Settings once active; default stays SegWit

descriptors.note: Emergency Kit PDF prints wsh(multi) and tr(musig) descriptors with key fingerprints, not xpubs; no descriptor import

own_server.note: Fixed to Muun's Houston API; no server setting. libwallet's Electrum client serves only a scan RPC the app never calls

verifies_chain.note: History, UTXOs and block height come from Muun's server; the app has no header, filter or block checks

tor.note: No Tor, I2P or proxy setting; the app talks to Muun's Houston HTTPS endpoint and Firebase/Google services

seed_standard.note: Recovery Code (not BIP 39) plus Emergency Kit; in-app restore asks Muun's server, outside restore needs Muun's Recovery Tool

cloud_backup.note: Emergency Kit PDF with keys encrypted to the Recovery Code is saved to iCloud Drive or Google Drive when the person exports it
